title: AWS opens its first Asia Pacific region in Singapore
description: AWS launched its Asia Pacific (Singapore) region, its first in the region, with multiple availability zones.
significance: Made Singapore the default cloud gateway for Southeast Asia for a decade.

title: Google opens its first Southeast Asian cloud region in Singapore
description: Google Cloud opened its Singapore region, its first in Southeast Asia and third in Asia.
significance: Confirmed the Singapore-first pattern for US hyperscalers.

title: Alibaba Cloud opens Malaysia's first public cloud data centre
description: Alibaba Cloud began operating a data centre in Kuala Lumpur, billed as Malaysia's first global public cloud platform.
significance: A Chinese hyperscaler reached Malaysia years before US cloud regions did.

title: Nongsa Digital Park opens in Batam
description: Singapore and Indonesian foreign ministers opened the first buildings of Nongsa Digital Park, a Batam park for IT firms and digital talent.
actor: Governments of Singapore and Indonesia; Citramas Group
significance: Set up Batam as Singapore's second overflow option, later a DayOne hyperscale campus.

title: Singapore pauses new data centre approvals
description: Singapore stopped approving new data centres in 2019, citing their heavy use of land, water and energy.
significance: Pushed new hyperscale demand across the causeway and seeded Johor's boom.

title: Google opens Jakarta cloud region
description: Google Cloud's Jakarta region went live, the first hyperscale cloud region in Indonesia.
significance: First US cloud region outside Singapore in Southeast Asia.

title: AWS launches Jakarta region
description: AWS launched its Asia Pacific (Jakarta) region with an estimated US$5bn of planned investment over 15 years.
significance: Indonesia's market size and data rules pulled AWS in ahead of Malaysia and Thailand.

title: Singapore lifts moratorium with strict conditions
description: Singapore lifted the moratorium in January 2022 and moved to selective approvals with sustainability conditions.
significance: Singapore stayed capacity constrained, so most new growth kept flowing to Johor.

title: Google plans cloud regions in Malaysia and Thailand
description: Google announced plans for new cloud regions in Malaysia, Thailand and New Zealand.
significance: Signalled the shift from a Singapore-only model to in-country regions.

title: US imposes sweeping chip export controls on China
description: The US Commerce Department restricted exports of advanced computing chips and chipmaking tools to China.
significance: Started the decoupling that made neutral Southeast Asian hosts valuable to both sides.

title: AWS announces Thailand region and US$5bn plan
description: AWS said it would open a three-zone Bangkok region and invest more than US$5bn over 15 years.
significance: First US hyperscaler region commitment in Thailand.

title: Philippines opens renewables to full foreign ownership
description: The Department of Energy revised the foreign investment negative list, removing the 40% cap on foreign ownership of renewable energy projects.
significance: Gave the Philippines a clean-power pitch to hyperscalers, which its later AI masterplan leans on.

title: AWS Local Zone opens in Manila
description: AWS made Local Zones generally available in Manila, a small edge footprint rather than a full region.
significance: First hyperscaler infrastructure in the Philippines; still no full US region.

title: TNB launches Green Lane Pathway for data centres
description: TNB launched a fast track aimed at cutting high-voltage grid connection for data centres from 36 to 48 months to about 12, with a one-stop centre.
significance: Speed to power became Johor's main edge over Singapore and the rest of the region.

title: Vietnam passes Telecoms Law open to foreign data centres
description: The National Assembly passed a new Telecoms Law with no restriction on direct foreign investment in data centre and cloud services; those provisions took effect 1 January 2025.
significance: Removed the ownership question for foreign operators, a precondition for Vietnam to compete.

title: YTL Power and Nvidia announce US$4.3bn AI data centre project
description: YTL Power said it would build Nvidia-based AI supercomputing at its Johor green data centre park.
significance: Marked Johor's turn from Singapore overflow to AI compute site.

title: Microsoft pledges US$1.7bn for Indonesian cloud and AI
description: Microsoft said it would invest US$1.7bn over four years in new cloud and AI infrastructure in Indonesia, its largest single investment there.
significance: Opened the 2024 wave of US mega pledges across the region.

title: Microsoft raises Malaysia commitment to US$2.2bn
description: Microsoft announced US$2.2bn for cloud and AI infrastructure in Malaysia over 2024 to 2028.
significance: Paired with the Indonesia pledge, it showed US firms spreading bets beyond Singapore.

title: Google pledges US$2bn for first Malaysian data centre
description: Google announced US$2bn for its first Malaysian data centre and cloud region; it broke ground at Elmina Business Park, Selangor, on 1 October 2024.
significance: Greater Kuala Lumpur, not only Johor, entered the hyperscale map.

title: AirTrunk opens 150MW JHB1 campus in Johor
description: Australia's AirTrunk opened its first Johor campus at over 150MW, with expansion under way.
significance: Showed hyperscale campuses could be delivered in Johor at a speed Singapore could not match.

title: AWS launches Malaysia region
description: AWS launched its Asia Pacific (Malaysia) region and raised its planned investment to about US$6.2bn through 2038.
significance: First full US hyperscale region in Malaysia.

title: AWS Thailand region goes live
description: AWS launched its three-zone Thailand region and restated more than US$5bn of long-term investment.
significance: First US hyperscale region live in Thailand.

title: Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone agreement signed
description: Malaysia and Singapore signed the JS-SEZ agreement, targeting 50 projects and 20,000 skilled jobs in five years.
significance: Formalised Johor as Singapore's hinterland, including for data centres.

title: AI Diffusion Rule puts most of Southeast Asia in Tier 2
description: The US AI Diffusion Rule (issued 15 January per BIS) left Singapore and other Southeast Asian countries in Tier 2, a capped middle tier for advanced AI chips; none were in Tier 1.
significance: For the first time US chip policy set limits on how much AI compute each host could import.

title: US rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule
description: Commerce rescinded the rule two days before compliance and said a replacement would follow.
significance: Removed the caps but left hosts guessing; diversion enforcement became the main tool instead.

title: Microsoft cloud regions go live in Malaysia and Indonesia
description: Microsoft's Malaysia West and Indonesia Central regions were reported live, under its US$2.2bn and US$1.7bn 2024 to 2028 commitments.
significance: Brought Microsoft to parity with AWS and Google in both countries.

title: Vietnam's Law on Data takes effect
description: The Law on Data 2024 took effect, tightening rules on important data and restricting its transfer abroad, with possible licensing of data services.
significance: Data localisation pressure creates in-country demand but adds compliance cost for foreign clouds.

title: Malaysia requires permits for US-origin AI chip exports
description: Malaysia's trade ministry required permits for exports and transshipment of high-performance US-origin AI chips.
significance: A host state started policing diversion itself to keep US chip access.

title: ADB and World Bank launch ASEAN Power Grid financing
description: ADB committed up to US$10bn over 10 years and the World Bank an initial US$2.5bn to finance cross-border ASEAN Power Grid links.
significance: The long-run fix for power-poor hubs, but years away from moving data centre load.

title: Johor stops approving water-intensive Tier 1 and 2 data centres
description: Johor said it would stop approving Tier 1 and Tier 2 data centres, which can use up to 50 million litres of water a day, and raise efficiency standards.
significance: First brake in the region's leading hub; constraint replaced speed as the story.

title: Google Cloud Bangkok region opens
description: Google Cloud opened a three-zone Bangkok region under its US$1bn Thailand investment.
significance: Second US hyperscale region live in Thailand.

title: Anwar confirms halt on approvals for non-AI data centres
description: Malaysia's prime minister said approvals for non-AI data centres were halted over energy and water concerns.
significance: Malaysia started choosing which compute it wants, not just how much.

title: DayOne signs 450MW Batam power deal
description: DayOne signed a PPA with PLN Batam for about 511MVA (about 450MW), delivered in phases in 2026 and 2027, billed as Indonesia's largest long-term PPA.
significance: Batam started to look like a second Johor for Singapore overflow.

title: AWS discusses up to US$5bn Philippine cloud region
description: President Marcos met AWS executives on a possible Philippine region; the government said investment could reach US$5bn over 15 years.
actor: Amazon Web Services; Government of the Philippines
significance: Would be the first full US hyperscale region in the Philippines; not yet confirmed by AWS as a launch.

title: Singapore awards 200MW in second data centre call
description: EDB and IMDA allocated 50MW each to Digital Realty, Equinix, Keppel DC and STT GDC from 20 proposals in the second call for application.
significance: Singapore keeps growing, but in rationed, high-efficiency tranches.

title: Thailand pauses 49 data centres under construction
description: A new supervision board paused 49 data centres under construction and 117 awaiting approval while rules were drafted; 35 were operating.
significance: Thailand stopped more projects than it had running, the sharpest host-state brake yet.

title: Philippines launches US$34.4bn AI infrastructure masterplan
description: DICT launched the AI+ Infrastructure Masterplan 2026 to 2033, targeting 1.5GW of AI data centre capacity by 2033 from about 50MW and US$12bn of private hyperscale investment.
significance: The clearest bid yet to be the next host after Malaysia and Thailand.

title: Google commits US$15bn more to Malaysia
description: Google announced US$15bn for 2027 to 2028, said its Elmina campus is operational, its Malaysia cloud region is upcoming, and it would add over 1GW of clean energy to the grid.
significance: The largest single pledge in the region came after the brakes, a sign that rules ration rather than stop investment.

title: Thai Cabinet endorses data centre rulebook
description: The Cabinet endorsed a framework requiring sites of 20MW or more to be in industrial estates, with noise, heat and water limits and economic-value screening.
significance: Ended Thailand's open-door phase; approvals now depend on local benefit and clean power.
